fields.description: Issue includes editorials and satire on post-election South Florida conditions, especially sharply rising rents in Miami and Miami Beach, and commentary on politics following the 1928 presidential election (Hoover vs. Al Smith). Contains local columns and notices on clubs, dances, theaters, and nightlife; discussion of Prohibition and liquor-running; a safety editorial on dangerous gasoline boats in the harbor; and assorted local news, advertisements, and society items.
